vibe_rationale: Community-trusted, carefully curated ideas festival with 23 years of history, but literary rather than street culture, so a narrower match to SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Affluent, educated readership in Ubud's wellness heartland; a quiet lounge or a health-and-wellbeing program strand could suit. A public partnership page and email, with more than a dozen partners, make the route open. Sessions on activism mean any brand role should be low-key. Australian share not published.
